gnome.line: Desktop icons are off in GNOME.

gnome.blocked: Extensions are off in GNOME. Turn them on in the Extensions app.

gnome.unknown: Desktop icons are off in GNOME.

startup.line: Scooch is off in Startup apps.

scenery.label: Clouds
scenery.tip: Clouds and islands around your icons.

flip.label: Flip

failure.turn-on: Scooch did not turn on. Try again.
failure.turn-off: Scooch did not turn off. Try again.
failure.held: Another program had Scooch's settings open. Try again in a moment.
failure.full: The disk is full. Make room, then try again.
failure.unwritable: Scooch could not save its settings. Check that its folder can be written.
failure.set: That setting did not change. Try again.
failure.use: That picture did not open. Pick another one.
failure.move: Scooch could not be copied to either Applications folder.
failure.admin: Scooch did not open again. Close it and open it from the Start menu.
failure.gnome-icons: Desktop icons did not turn on. Log out and back in, then try again.
failure.open: That window did not open. Try again.
failure.start: Scooch did not start again. Try again.
failure.view: Scooch could not read its state. Try again.
failure.pictures: Your pictures did not load. Try again.

dmg.first: In System Settings, press Privacy and Security, then Open Anyway.
